sources.officialProductEvidence: The official Salomon page confirms sizes 157/165/173/181/189 cm, 106 mm waist, Freeride Profile, Rocker-Camber-Rocker, 16.5 m radius (page's displayed reference), Full Poplar Woodcore, Ti Binding Reinforcement, Basalt Superlight Fibers, Fiberglass, Full Sandwich Sidewalls and Cork Damplifier.
sources.sizeTableEvidence: The 2026/27 Salomon catalogue table lists per-length tip/waist/tail, radius, and weight for all five sizes. The weight values are not mapped because the current seed schema does not preserve the catalog's per-ski/unit context without ambiguity.

mappingNotes: The seed's turnRadius uses the 173 cm reference (18.5 m); all size-specific sidecut and radius values are retained.

No numeric weight was added because the official product page's 3000 g net-weight field does not identify its reference length or per-ski/per-pair basis, while the catalogue uses a distinct per-ski table.
